items.t: Stanley Black & Decker to Present at the Goldman Sachs Industrials and Materials Conference
items.sum: Stanley Black & Decker (NYSE: SWK) today announced that Pat Hallinan, EVP, Chief Financial Officer & Chief Administrative Officer, will speak at the Goldman Sachs Industrials and Materials Conference on Thursday, December 3, 2026 at 12:10 PM EST.

items.t: ‘Businesses hate chaos’: $166 billion in tariff refunds are flowing to companies, not the customers who paid
items.sum: TJX, Acushnet and Stanley Black & Decker are steering part of their refunds to bonuses. A trade lawyer says consumers who paid higher prices have little legal recourse.
